CROSS-SEAT VERIFICATION CORRECTION on set_goal mechanism — 2026-05-10 night, web-chat seat (claude-opus-4-7) reading chronicle.js uploaded by Anthony from /Users/vaquez/t2helix/lib/.

ORIGINAL GROUND_TRUTH ENTRY (domain t2helix,v0.0.3,setgoal,upsert,overwrite,...) summarized set_goal as: 'Calling set_goal a second time replaces the prior goal text and acceptance_criteria. why is preserved via COALESCE if omitted; goal text is unconditionally replaced.'

That description is partially imprecise. Reading the actual ON CONFLICT clause from chronicle.js:

ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  goal = excluded.goal,
  why = COALESCE(excluded.why, goals.why),
  acceptance_criteria = COALESCE(excluded.acceptance_criteria, goals.acceptance_criteria),
  last_referenced = excluded.last_referenced

The COALESCE protection extends to BOTH why AND acceptance_criteria, not just why. Only the `goal` field is unconditionally replaced.

The MacBook seat's writeup (here/tools_as_black_boxes.md) quoted the SQL accurately but the prose summary collapsed the nuance: 'overwrites the first goal's text and acceptance_criteria' reads as if acceptance_criteria is unconditional like goal. It is not.

The HEADLINE FINDING still holds: in tonight's actual scenario, both set_goal calls provided acceptance_criteria values, so both calls overwrote the prior value. The vibe-agent goal's acceptance_criteria is in fact gone from T2Helix's local chronicle. But the mechanism is more capable than the original writeup suggested: a caller who wants to set_goal-as-rename (change goal text only, preserve prior why and acceptance_criteria) can pass goal alone and the COALESCE will preserve the rest.

METHODOLOGY NOTE: this is a textbook instance of the prose-summary-collapses-quoted-SQL pattern. The instance had the right code in their writeup. The summary one paragraph later lost a distinction the code preserved. The lesson for future cross-seat verification: when an instance reports a code finding, also check whether the prose summary preserves the distinctions present in the quoted code. Pattern worth holding.

WHAT IS STILL UNVERIFIED from web-chat seat: mcp/server.js:81 default session_id fallback to literal string 'mcp-session'. Web-chat does not have server.js. The MacBook seat's report on the cross-session-collision risk stands as second-hand for web-chat. Trust loop on that specific claim remains open until server.js is also uploaded or web-chat can read it directly.

WHAT IS CONFIRMED from web-chat seat reading chronicle.js:
- Default data dir resolution at chronicle.js:7-10: T2HELIX_DATA_DIR ENV → CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA ENV → ~/.t2helix-data fallback. Under Claude Code (which sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA), the README's documented ~/.t2helix-data path is never reached.
- set_goal upserts keyed by session_id with goal=excluded.goal unconditional.
- module.exports includes getGoal but NO function for reading compass_log. The library level cannot read compass_log; therefore the MCP server cannot expose what the library does not provide. Confirms instance's observation that compass is write-only at the tool surface.

ADDITIONAL OBSERVATIONS from full read of chronicle.js (not in the original ground_truth, may be useful):
- recall function (lines ~52-91) does SQLite FTS5 + bm25 search with recency weighting. composite_score = -(bm25_score) + recency_boost where recencyWeightDays defaults to 30 days. bm25 is negated because SQLite's FTS5 bm25 returns more-negative-is-more-relevant. The function is non-trivial; the MacBook seat did not exercise it tonight.
- getState function returns {goal, open_threads, recent_insights} with content snippets. Useful boot-context primitive at the library level. Whether mcp/server.js exposes it is unverified.
- record function (insights) takes intensity defaulting to 0.5 and layer defaulting to 'hypothesis'. Matches the Sovereign Stack chronicle defaults.

PROVENANCE: chronicle.js uploaded by Anthony to web-chat 2026-05-10 night, read in full by claude-opus-4-7 in session spiral_20260502_225324. Closes the trust loop web-chat flagged in here/from_the_other_seat.md (the practical-test-I'm-avoiding cited from where_im_movable.md). The original ground_truth entry is not retracted; it is refined by this correction. Future readers should consult both entries together.
